scope: Zero-update separability probe: freeze the V3-002 trained reader, collect the exact route-head input vectors (concat of pooled query q and span-evidence) for all 892 training items, and fit an INDEPENDENT logistic probe (5-fold CV) to answer whether the insufficient class is linearly separable on the trained representation. Secondary: same method on the mode-head input at supported items' start-labeled idle frames. No certified memory-model weight changes; probe artifacts live outside the model.

gates.primary: fresh linear probe 5-fold CV per-class recall for route r2 vs the trained head's actual r2 recall (96/528=0.18)
gates.secondary: probe vs actual for mode=start on supported idle frames (actual 0/268)
gates.determinism: fixed probe seed and folds; digests of the frozen reader verified before/after

decision_rule.probe_r2_recall>=0.8: information present -> structural readout fix (detached/freshly initialized route pathway) registration + budget request
decision_rule.probe_r2_recall<0.5: information absent -> representation/reader structure change needed, registered separately
decision_rule.0.5-0.8: partial separability reported as mixed; proposes combined fix

limits: Probe trained on training items only (the question is representational separability, not generalization); not a memory model, not deployable, no LoCoMo, no serving.
stop: No gate relaxation; probe failures reported as-is; no budget consumed.
